welcomeHeading: A Message from the President & Vice President
alumniBody: The Law Students Union (LSU) of Kings University College is embarking on an important initiative to establish a comprehensive alumni network — a bridge between past and present law students that strengthens our Faculty of Law community.
welcomeBody: Welcome to the Law Students' Union of Kings University College. Whether you're beginning your journey or preparing for the next chapter, know that the Union is here to support, represent, and empower you. We encourage you to get involved, stay informed, and make the most of everything our community has to offer. Thank you for being part of this journey. We look forward to building a stronger and more united Law Students' Union with you. With warm regards, The President & Vice President, Law Students' Union.
legalTreeTeaser: The Dr. Attakora Legal Tree is a groundbreaking online platform designed to revolutionize the way law students at Kings University College access and engage with legal knowledge. Named after the Head of our Department, Dr. Attakora, it is a one-stop-shop for Past Questions, Textbooks, Law Reports, Journals, and more.
announcementBody: Attention all law students! The LSU kindly reminds you of the importance of paying your dues on time. Your contributions fund essential resources, events, and initiatives for the entire law student community.

legalHubBody: Launched 19th June 2026, the George-More Legal Hub is the Union's academic resource hub — past questions, recorded tutorial sessions, seminars, and other learning materials, all in one place. Scan the QR code on campus notice boards or use the link below.
